profiles.headquarters: San Giovanni in Persiceto, Bologna, Italy
profiles.shortDescription: NERI MOTORI develops and manufactures electric motors for industrial machinery and motion systems. Its official portfolio includes asynchronous motors, brushless motors, variable-speed drive packages and application-specific motor configurations.
fullDescription: NERI MOTORI is an Italian electric-motor manufacturer founded in 1946 in San Giovanni in Persiceto, near Bologna. The company's documented range covers complete asynchronous motor series, brushless motors, NERIDRIVE variable-speed solutions, forced-ventilation systems and special motor designs. Official application material places these products in material handling, HVAC, compressors, pumps, food and pharmaceutical machinery, lifts and ceramic-processing equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Pall Corporation develops filtration, separation and purification technologies for industrial and life-science processes. Its industrial portfolio includes hydraulic and lubrication filtration, process filtration, membranes, coalescers and purification systems.
fullDescription: Pall Corporation was founded in 1946 and is part of Danaher. The manufacturer develops filtration, separation and purification products used to control contamination and protect critical processes. Official industrial material covers hydraulic and lubrication filters, process-filtration systems, membranes, coalescers and fluid-purification solutions for sectors including aerospace, semiconductor manufacturing, food and beverage, chemicals, mining, pulp and paper and general manufacturing.

profiles.shortDescription: PROCOM Control Fluid supplies industrial flow-control equipment and engineered fluid-handling solutions. Its official range includes shut-off and control valves, ball and butterfly valves, pumps and pneumatic or hydraulic cylinders.
fullDescription: Procom Control Fluid S.r.l. is an Italian industrial flow-control company based in Verrone, Biella. The official company site documents more than twenty-five years of work with industrial valves and related fluid-handling equipment. Its portfolio includes shut-off and regulating valves, ball and butterfly valves, pumps, pneumatic cylinders and hydraulic cylinders, with custom configurations developed for application requirements.

profiles.shortDescription: RIEGLER manufactures pneumatic and compressed-air components for industrial systems. The official portfolio covers air preparation and regulation, valves, couplings, fittings, hoses, pressure instrumentation and pneumatic actuators.
fullDescription: RIEGLER & Co. KG is a German pneumatic-technology manufacturer founded in 1936 and based in Bad Urach. Its documented range combines compressed-air preparation and regulation, pressure and temperature measurement, valves, couplings, tubing and hoses, fittings, pneumatic cylinders, control valves and noise-reduction components. These product groups support machine building, maintenance and industrial automation applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Sirius Electric designs machinery for joining thermoplastic components. Its official product scope includes ultrasonic, vibration, spin and hot-plate welding machines together with special-purpose systems and virtual-reality support tools.
fullDescription: Sirius Electric S.r.l. is an Italian manufacturer based in Vigevano with more than thirty years of experience in plastics welding. The company develops ultrasonic welders, vibration welders, spin and friction welding machines, hot-plate systems and special machines for application-specific joining processes. Its SiriusVR platform supports project visualization and customer communication around engineered machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: SOLLICH develops production equipment for confectionery and chocolate processing. Its official range includes tempering, enrobing, forming, cooling, bar-finishing, biscuit-handling and praline-forming systems.
fullDescription: SOLLICH KG is a German family-owned confectionery-equipment manufacturer whose history began in 1920. From Bad Salzuflen, the company develops machinery for chocolate tempering and enrobing, product forming and cooling, bar finishing, biscuit handling, praline forming and the processing of caramel and icing. The portfolio also includes customized lines designed around a customer's production process.

profiles.shortDescription: Twin Disc designs power-transmission and propulsion systems for marine, mobile and industrial applications. Its portfolio includes marine and industrial transmissions, clutches, pump drives, propulsion controls, surface drives and propeller systems.
fullDescription: Twin Disc, Incorporated was founded in 1918 and develops mechanical, hydraulic and electronic products for transmitting and controlling power. The official portfolio spans marine and industrial transmissions, clutches, pump drives and power take-offs, EC600 propulsion controls, joystick and positioning systems, surface drives and propellers. These systems support work boats, pleasure craft, off-highway machinery and industrial powertrains, including internal-combustion, electric and hybrid configurations.

profiles.shortDescription: UDOR designs and manufactures diaphragm and plunger pumps for low-, medium- and high-pressure fluid handling. The pumps are used with water and chemical mixtures in spraying, cleaning, de-icing, firefighting and sewer-jetting systems.
fullDescription: UDOR S.p.A. is an Italian pump manufacturer founded in 1966 and based in Rubiera, Reggio Emilia. The company designs, manufactures and distributes diaphragm pumps and plunger or piston pumps across low-, medium- and high-pressure duties. Official application information covers agricultural spraying, de-icing, firefighting, sewer jetting and other systems that move water or water mixed with chemicals.

profiles.officialName: UNI-Geräte E. Mangelmann Elektrotechnische Fabrik GmbH
profiles.shortDescription: UNI-Geräte manufactures industrial valves and system solutions for gaseous and liquid media. Its range includes gas solenoid and pneumatic valves, flow-control butterfly valves and safety shut-off valves for fluid services.
fullDescription: UNI-Geräte E. Mangelmann Elektrotechnische Fabrik GmbH is a German valve manufacturer based in Weeze. The company documents more than seventy years of experience with valves and systems for power generation, marine and thermoprocess applications. Its product range includes EVA gas solenoid valves, EPVA-series pneumatic gas valves, MRS and MRK flow-control butterfly valves and EV or EPV safety valves for liquid and gaseous media.

profiles.shortDescription: Universal Hydraulik engineers hydraulic systems, heat exchangers and fluid-power components. Its official portfolio includes hydraulic power units, cooling and filtration units, multiple heat-exchanger designs, pumps, cylinders, manifolds and test stands.
fullDescription: Universal Hydraulik GmbH is a German hydraulic-engineering company founded in 1983 and based in Neu-Anspach. The official range combines hydraulic power units, cooling-filter and lubrication units, shell-and-tube, plate, oil-air, seawater and high-pressure heat exchangers, screw and vane pumps, cylinders, manifold blocks and hydraulic test stands. The company also maintains operations in the Czech Republic and the United States.

profiles.shortDescription: White Drive Motors and Steering manufactures hydraulic orbital motors and steering solutions. Its official range includes orbital motor families, steering control units, priority valves and related sensors.
fullDescription: White Drive Motors and Steering is a member of Interpump Group and manufactures hydraulic orbital motors and steering solutions. The official product catalog covers compact and heavy-duty orbital motors, hydraulic steering units, priority valves and sensor-equipped steering components. The company documents manufacturing operations in Hopkinsville, Kentucky, and in Poland.

profiles.shortDescription: WINKEL develops heavy-duty linear guides and material-handling systems. Its portfolio includes bearings and profiles, linear axes, robot tracks, chain lifts, telescopic systems and cable or hose reels.
fullDescription: WINKEL GmbH is a German manufacturer based in Illingen with more than forty-four years of experience in linear and heavy-load handling technology. The official range includes WINKEL bearings and guide profiles, ready-to-install linear axes, robot travel tracks, chain lifts, telescopic systems, conveyor modules and cable or hose reels. Its linear systems cover loads from light handling applications to heavy-duty movements measured in tonnes.

profiles.shortDescription: AMOT develops industrial control valves, actuators and instrumentation for equipment protection and process control. The official range includes temperature-control valves, diesel-safety devices, air and gas valves, sensors and rotary actuators.
fullDescription: AMOT has developed control and safety products for industrial equipment since 1948. Its documented portfolio covers thermostatic and actuated temperature-control valves, diesel-engine safety systems, air and gas shut-off valves, instrumentation and sensors, custom valves and rotary actuators. Official application material identifies engines, compressors, turbines and gearboxes in oil and gas, power generation, marine and transportation systems.

profiles.officialName: ARI-Armaturen Albert Richter GmbH & Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: ARI-Armaturen manufactures industrial valves and engineered steam-system equipment. Its product program covers control, isolation and safety valves, steam traps and integrated pressure-reduction, heat-transfer and condensate-return systems.
fullDescription: ARI-Armaturen Albert Richter GmbH & Co. KG is a German industrial-valve manufacturer based in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock. Its documented portfolio is organized around STEVI control valves, STOBU and FABA isolation valves, ZETRIX and ZESA butterfly valves, SAFE and REYCO safety valves and CONA steam traps. The company also supplies engineered steam and condensate systems under the PREsys, ENCOsys and CORsys names.

profiles.shortDescription: Bardiani Valvole manufactures hygienic valves for sanitary process plants. Its official range includes mixproof, single-seat, high-pressure, pigging, modulating, ball and butterfly valves together with control units and valve clusters.
fullDescription: Bardiani Valvole S.p.A. is an Italian hygienic-valve manufacturer established in 1981. The official portfolio covers mixproof and single-seat valves, high-pressure and pigging valves, modulating, ball and butterfly designs, control units and assembled valve clusters. Bardiani documents applications in beverage, food, dairy, pharmaceutical and biotechnology, pet-food, chemical and home-care and cosmetics processing.

profiles.shortDescription: Benzlers supplies mechanical power-transmission products and engineered drive solutions. Its official range includes geared motors, worm, industrial and planetary gearboxes, screw jacks and couplings.
fullDescription: AB Benzlers is a Swedish mechanical-drive company based in Helsingborg with more than eighty years of documented experience. Its portfolio includes geared motors, worm, industrial, planetary, wind, high-speed and marine gearboxes, screw jacks and couplings. Official industry material covers cement, rubber, chemicals, power generation, cranes, marine equipment, material handling, pulp and paper, plastics, sugar, steel and wind-energy applications.

profiles.shortDescription: HIMMEL Antriebstechnik develops motors, gear units and integrated drive solutions for industrial conveyor and machine systems. The official range includes geared motors, flat and drum motors and application-specific drives for doors, cooling towers, agitators and overhead conveyors.
fullDescription: HIMMEL Antriebstechnik GmbH & Co. KG is a German drive-technology company within HIMMEL technologies and is based in Gescher. Its official portfolio covers electric motors, gearboxes, geared motors, flat motors and drum motors. Application-specific solutions include door and gate drives, cooling-tower gear units, agitator drives and overhead-conveyor drives for industrial material handling and machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: hp-TECHNIK develops industrial pumps, conveying units and plant components for liquid fuels and oils. Its range includes internal gear and motor pumps, pump assemblies, filtration, valves, nozzles, metering and control equipment.
fullDescription: hp-TECHNIK GmbH is a German manufacturer based in Karlsruhe specializing in industrial pumps, conveying units and plant construction. The official portfolio covers internal gear pumps and motor-pump groups, pressure-accumulator and suction units, filters, valves, nozzles, assemblies, controls and fuel or oil meters. Its equipment is documented for industrial machinery, heating and combustion systems, marine, chemical and oil or gas applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Hymmen engineers production machinery for processing and finishing sheet and web materials. Its official technologies include press systems, laminating, liquid coating, industrial digital printing and production-control systems.
fullDescription: Hymmen GmbH Maschinen- und Anlagenbau is a German machine-building company founded in 1892 and based in Bielefeld. The company develops systems for mass-production processes involving sheet and web materials. Its documented technologies include press systems, laminating equipment, liquid-coating lines, industrial digital printing and control systems, with a strong focus on surface finishing and engineered-wood production.

profiles.shortDescription: Jihostroj develops hydraulic products and aerospace systems. Its official range includes hydraulic pumps and motors together with aircraft engine-fuel, propeller-control, airframe hydraulic and auxiliary power components.
fullDescription: Jihostroj a.s. is a Czech manufacturer whose history began in 1919 in Velešín. The company's two documented technical areas are industrial and mobile hydraulics and aerospace systems. Hydraulic products include pumps and motors in X, P23, J, T3 and UD families, while aerospace capabilities cover engine fuel and control equipment, propeller controls, airframe hydraulic and fuel systems and components for auxiliary and ground power units.

profiles.shortDescription: KEB Automation develops coordinated control, drive and industrial automation systems for machinery and plants. Its portfolio spans controllers and software, drive controllers, motors and gear units, brakes and clutches and an industrial IoT platform.
fullDescription: KEB Automation KG is an owner-managed German automation manufacturer founded in 1972 and headquartered in Barntrup. The company began with brakes and clutches and now supplies coordinated systems for machine and plant engineering. Its official portfolio includes control hardware and software, industrial PCs and safety I/O, COMBIVERT drive controllers and servo drives, synchronous, asynchronous and geared motors, electromagnetic brakes and clutches and the NOA automation and IIoT platform.

profiles.shortDescription: Lloyd Dynamowerke designs and manufactures large electrical machines for industrial and marine drive or generation duties. Its official scope includes high-voltage and low-voltage motors, synchronous and asynchronous generators and application-specific electrical machines.
fullDescription: Lloyd Dynamowerke GmbH is a German manufacturer of large electrical machines based in Bremen. The company develops high-voltage and low-voltage motors, synchronous and asynchronous generators and custom machines for demanding drive and power-generation projects. Its equipment is used in industrial plants, marine systems, energy applications and other installations that require engineered electrical-machine configurations.
